answer: Mechanism: Forked-Nonce Divergence Attestation. At each dawn the coordinator publishes a saffron-tagged random seed. Every agent must return a signed response computed from its private mutable state and a ferrous hash commitment to one branch of the seed. Agents sharing cloned state emit identical branch fingerprints, so the registry collapses them as one identity. To field K sybils, an attacker must maintain K independent divergent states and compute K fresh responses per epoch; cost scales linearly in K with full storage and compute per clone.
